The geometry and material checkpoints align well with the visual evidence of a polished, contoured metal plate. However, the Router may have been slightly lenient on the 'Ornamental details' checkpoint; while patterns exist, their coherence is questionable (see artifact review).
artifact_review: The Router identified a 'structural_collapse' on the right hip (severity 3) and a 'texture_anomaly' at the bottom edge (severity 2). I agree with the severity of the right-side object; it is geometrically nonsensical and likely an AI hallucination or severe corruption. The topology mask shows high confidence (0.96), but this only confirms the main body is segmented, not that the peripheral artifacts are valid. The perceptual auditor noted slight compression, which is consistent with the image quality but does not explain the structural collapse. The embossed pattern on the abdomen, upon closer inspection, appears somewhat 'mushy' and lacks the crisp edges of real metal embossing, suggesting a potential texture generation artifact that the Router under-weighted.
alignment_reasoning: The fine_grained_classifier strongly confirms the class ('breastplate' rank 1, 'cuirass' rank 2), indicating high semantic alignment. 8 out of 9 checkpoints are fully met. The missing shoulder straps are a minor functional omission in the visible view but do not negate the class identity. The score is penalized slightly because the 'ornamental details' checkpoint, while technically present, exhibits low-fidelity characteristics typical of AI generation, reducing the 'perfect conformance' score.
